author: laura.desmet@lumivia.be
title: Work Regulations (Arbeidsreglement) Lumivia NV - Chapter 7: Absence due to illness
body:
Work Regulations of Lumivia NV, version in force from 15 January 2019.

Chapter 7 - Absence due to illness or accident

Article 7.1 - An employee who is unable to work due to illness or accident must inform their direct manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence.

Article 7.2 - The employee must communicate the expected duration of the absence and the address where they are staying if different from their home address.

Article 7.3 - For every absence due to illness, regardless of its duration, the employee must submit a medical certificate within 48 hours from the start of the absence.

Article 7.4 - The employer may have the employee examined by a control doctor of its choice.

Signed on behalf of Lumivia NV and the employee representatives.
